trigger.description: A binary pack frame declares a format version newer than this reader supports.
setup_commands:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/tmp/pack.eepk')
b = bytearray(p.read_bytes())
b[4:6] = (2).to_bytes(2, 'little')
p.write_bytes(b)
PY

expected_emission.repair_contains: Regenerate the pack with a reader-compatible ee version
